headline: DNS resolves fine, TCP 443 is open, but the TLS handshake fails because client and server share no TLS version: this client offers TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3, the server only accepts TLSv1.0.

findings.message: TLS handshake failed: client and server share no TLS version: this client offers TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3, the server only accepts TLSv1.0.
findings.remedy: Enable TLS 1.2 or 1.3 on the server (ssl_protocols / SSLProtocol), or upgrade the client. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are deprecated (RFC 8996).
